facts.fact: Digital Transition Minister Aminata Zerbo/Sabane said in April 2025 that the government has put SOC and CSIRT centres into service to detect threats and coordinate incident response.

BFA.note: National cybercrime strategy 2025-2029 is a cybercrime strategy; the 200+ monthly alerts of 2023 are recorded, not stated as issued by the body.

facts.fact: Burkina Faso adopted a law on the security of information systems in July 2024, per Agence Ecofin.
facts.system: Loi portant securite des systemes d'information

BFA.note: Alerte-BCLCC reports cybercrime, not public-service complaints.
